## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what the problem is or what use case is currently unsupported.

## Offline & Privacy Impact
Explain how this feature maintains Daynexa's core principles:

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup sketches, or references here.
